title: Curate Cad In Palette Action Flags
description: Curate CAD in_palette action flags in create_cad_app() so internal pointer/engagement plumbing actions are excluded from the command palette and context menus.
summary: Curated CAD's action in_palette flags in create_cad_app(): (1) Added with_in_palette and in_palette builder methods to ActionDefinition in semio-framework-core (🧰️framework/⚡️implementation/🦀️rust/📦️lib.rs); (2) Marked all 20 internal/plumbing actions (worldHover, setHover, worldPick, engagementInput, engagementPossibleSelect, engagementRepeatLast, engagementAbort, worldPointerDown, worldPointerMove, engagementPointerDown, referenceHover, setSelectionMethod, setSelection, setNodeSelection, setReferenceSelection, setPrimitiveSelection, setDislocateOption, patchCadPlayReference, engagementSubmit, worldSelect) with in_palette: false in create_cad_app(); (3) Extended CAD's unit tests with internal_and_plumbing_actions_excluded_from_palette() to assert that internal plumbing actions have in_palette: false and user actions retain in_palette: true; (4) Verified all 65 unit tests in semio-s-app-cad-ui pass cleanly.
